description: Establish the year-aware foundation in @mlb/shared: a single source-of-truth season config (CURRENT_YEAR = 2026, SELECTABLE_SEASONS, and a season-status helper), extend the TEAMS map with the 2025 postseason teams, and add a real aggregated 2025 seed dataset so getSeedBracket serves both 2024 and 2025. This is the base other features depend on. Baseline build+test are already green.
steps: In shared/src/, add a new module (e.g. shared/src/season.ts) exporting a single CURRENT_YEAR constant = 2026 (documented as the app's 'now', easy to change later), a SELECTABLE_SEASONS array = [2024, 2025, 2026] (newest-first ordering is fine; document the choice), and a pure helper `seasonMode(season: number): 'results' | 'predictable'` (or an equivalent `isResultsOnly`/`isPredictable`) where any season < CURRENT_YEAR is 'results' and season === CURRENT_YEAR is 'predictable'. Keep it dependency-free so both backend and frontend can import it. Export it from shared/src/index.ts.

Extend the TEAMS record in shared/src/types.ts with the teams that appear in the 2025 postseason but are missing today: 111 Boston Red Sox (AL), 112 Chicago Cubs (NL), 113 Cincinnati Reds (NL), 136 Seattle Mariners (AL), 141 Toronto Blue Jays (AL). Keep existing entries. Update the doc comment that says the map is '2024' teams to note it now covers 2024 and 2025 postseason teams.

Generate shared/src/seed/postseason-2025.json by fetching real data from the live MLB Stats API and aggregating it with the SAME logic as backend/src/mlb/aggregate.ts so the shape is identical to postseason-2024.json. Recommended approach: run a one-off Node/tsx script (in a single shell command, since /tmp does not persist across calls) that fetches https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/schedule/postseason?sportId=1&season=2025, feeds the games through aggregateBracket(games, 2025), and writes the JSON to shared/src/seed/postseason-2025.json. Confirmed real result: 47 final games, Los Angeles Dodgers (119) beat Toronto Blue Jays (141) 4-3 in the World Series. Set a stable updatedAt (e.g. the WS final date 2025-11-02T00:00:00.000Z) rather than Date.now() so the committed seed is deterministic. If the live API is unreachable at implementation time, flag it as a blocker (do NOT fabricate scores).

Update shared/src/seed/index.ts: import postseason-2025.json, export a POSTSEASON_2025 constant, and change getSeedBracket to return POSTSEASON_2024 for 2024 and POSTSEASON_2025 for 2025 (2026 and others return undefined). Update the module doc comment accordingly.

Add/extend unit tests in shared (create shared/src/season.test.ts and a shared/src/seed/seed.test.ts if none exist, following the vitest conventions used in backend/frontend). Cover: seasonMode(2024)==='results', seasonMode(2025)==='results', seasonMode(2026)==='predictable'; getSeedBracket returns a bracket for 2024 and 2025 and undefined for 2026/2027; the 2025 seed's World Series series resolves to Dodgers (119) as champion with a 4-3 score and status 'final'; every teamId referenced in the 2025 seed exists in TEAMS. If shared has no test runner wired yet, add a vitest config/script mirroring backend's so `npm test` picks it up.
acceptance_criteria: shared exports CURRENT_YEAR (=2026), SELECTABLE_SEASONS (=[2024,2025,2026]), and a season-status helper, all importable from @mlb/shared.
getSeedBracket(2024) and getSeedBracket(2025) both return a valid Bracket; getSeedBracket(2026) returns undefined.
shared/src/seed/postseason-2025.json exists, has season=2025, all four rounds, AL/NL/WS series, World Series final = Dodgers 4-3 over Blue Jays, and every teamId is present in TEAMS.
`npm run build` exits 0 and `npm test` passes including the new shared tests.
verification: Run `npm run build` from repo root and confirm exit 0.
Run `npm test` and confirm all tests pass including new shared season/seed tests.
Confirm shared/src/seed/postseason-2025.json parses as JSON and its World Series series shows teamId 119 clinching 4 wins.
findings: Added shared/src/season.ts (CURRENT_YEAR=2026, SELECTABLE_SEASONS=[2026,2025,2024] newest-first, seasonMode/isResultsOnly/isPredictable) and exported it from shared/src/index.ts. Extended TEAMS with 111 BOS, 112 CHC, 113 CIN, 136 SEA, 141 TOR. Generated shared/src/seed/postseason-2025.json from LIVE statsapi (47 final games) via backend aggregateBracket(games,2025); stable updatedAt 2025-11-02T00:00:00.000Z. 11 series across all 4 rounds; WS id 2025-ws-worldseries-141-119, status final, Blue Jays(141)=high 3 wins, Dodgers(119)=low 4 wins (Dodgers champion 4-3). getSeedBracket now serves 2024+2025, undefined otherwise; POSTSEASON_2025 exported. Added shared/src/season.test.ts and shared/src/seed/seed.test.ts (14 tests, all green). `npm run build` exits 0. PRE-EXISTING unrelated backend failures (not caused by this change, reproduced on base via git stash): (1) bedrock/narrative.test.ts expects old model id 'anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0' but code now returns 'us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0' (from prior commit 92c9f36); (2) mlb/aggregate.property.test.ts is flaky/fails intermittently on base too (win-count vs clinch invariant with mixed gamesInSeries inputs). Shared tests and build are green.
